snippet.title: Inselnova: Build, Expand, Attack in a Living Island Strategy World
snippet.description:
Set sail for Inselnova, a free browser strategy game inspired by the old-school classics like Travian, OGame, and Inselkampf.

Build your island, expand your realm, form alliances, trade with other players, and strike when the tide is right. Inselnova is a persistent multiplayer world where diplomacy, timing, and long-term strategy matter.

No pay-to-win.
Works on desktop and mobile.
Free to play.
